TenantTabs includes ExtPay.js 3.1.2 under LGPLv3 and webextension-polyfill 0.7.0
under MPL-2.0. TenantTabs' original application code remains proprietary.
Recipients retain the rights granted by the component licences.

Complete licence texts, the exact covered source and applicable build materials
are supplied in this compliance source distribution. NOTICES.txt provides pinned
public upstream downloads; source-provenance.json identifies the corresponding
archives. The publisher must link the approved compliance repository/source
download next to the actual application download before distribution.
Intended compliance location (this directory is not yet uploaded):
https://github.com/migotech-apps/TenantTabs/tree/main/third-party/extpay

Library modification/recombination instructions are in build-instructions.txt and
REPLACEMENT.txt. The corresponding proprietary application is obtained only via
its authorised distribution; it is not included in this repository. PERMISSION.txt
provides the limited replacement permission for adoption in those delivered terms.

Modifying a signed XPI invalidates its signature. Temporary development loading
is session-limited; permanent installation on release/beta Firefox normally
requires Mozilla signing. No signing key or Mozilla approval is promised by
these materials. The section 4(d)(0) application-material and installation review
must be resolved before the publisher claims complete LGPL compliance.
